title: Wald-Brände - In einigen Regionen in Deutschland riecht es nach Feuer
titleTranslation: Forest Fires - In Some Regions of Germany It Smells Like Fire
summary: Large forest fires in Germany and Belgium are sending smoke and fine dust into German cities like Cologne and Bonn, prompting health warnings, though rain expected this week should help.

title: 台風13号 影響は長時間続く 警戒を 台風15号の動きは?
titleTranslation: Typhoon No. 13's effects to continue for a long time — stay alert; what about Typhoon No. 15's movement?
summary: Large, very strong Typhoon No. 13 is moving through waters west of Okinawa's main island, bringing prolonged wind and rain to Okinawa and Amami, with residents urged to remain on strict alert for landslides and other hazards.
